headline: LME copper falls 5% and drops back under $12,000 as the Nvidia bounce fades
detail: On Nov 24, LME three-month copper fell about 5% to roughly $11,858/t, with aluminum, zinc and tin also sharply lower, blamed on a stronger dollar and selling in AI stocks. Expect copper scrap bids to slip again.

headline: Nucor raises its weekly hot-rolled coil price another $20 to $1,330 a ton
detail: The consumer spot price rose $20 to $1,330 per short ton and lead times held at 3-5 weeks. Wide mill margins support steady to firm demand for prime and shredded scrap going into December.

headline: US expected to announce higher tariffs on China, the EU and 14 other economies
detail: AP reports the trade office will soon release findings from a probe into subsidized industrial production, with new tariffs to replace the broad duties the Supreme Court struck down in February. Renewed trade tension helped knock base metals lower.

headline: October PCE inflation and revised Q3 GDP come out this morning, the last big test before the December Fed meeting
detail: Core PCE is expected near 3.8% a year and Q3 GDP near 3.5%, with durable goods and jobless claims at the same time. A hot reading would lock in a December rate hike and a firmer dollar, both bad for metals.

headline: US copper premium flips to a discount and metal starts heading back to China
detail: Most LME and CME copper stocks now sit in the US, and with the tariff trade unwinding COMEX trades below London while China's import premium hits records. A COMEX discount weighs directly on US copper scrap values.

headline: Washington weighs a refined copper tariff while speculators cut bullish copper bets to a 20-month low
detail: A 15% duty on refined copper from January 2027, rising to 30% in 2028, is under consideration. Net speculative longs fell 39% in a week, and BMO warns copper could slide to $10,000-11,000/t without clarity.

headline: LME aluminum drops 3% as the near-term supply squeeze eases
detail: Three-month aluminum fell to about $2,768/t on Nov 24 and the gap between cash and three-month prices narrowed sharply. A loosening squeeze points to softer aluminum scrap pricing.

headline: Gold falls 2% and silver 5% as traders lock in a December Fed hike
detail: Spot gold ended Nov 24 near $3,557 and silver near $40.84 after hawkish Fed comments and a selloff in AI stocks that forced some investors to sell metal to cover margin calls.

headline: Platinum and palladium slide again, hitting catalytic converter values
detail: Platinum fell about 3.7% and palladium about 4.6% on Nov 24, with platinum down roughly 21% in a month. Expect lower converter grading prices from refiners and processors.

headline: Fed minutes show nearly all officials see more rate hikes, with the 10-year yield above 5%
detail: Minutes from the October meeting show almost all policymakers expect further increases, and futures put a December hike near 90%. Higher rates and a strong dollar have been driving the metals selloff.

headline: Iron ore stays below $90 as Chinese steel output hits an eight-month low
detail: Singapore iron ore futures held near $88/t as China's hot metal output fell for a sixth week and few Chinese mills are profitable. Weak Chinese steel means cheap exports competing with US steel and scrap.

headline: China tightens rules for copper scrap recyclers and opens the door to processing hubs abroad
detail: New Chinese policy documents tighten invoicing and compliance and call for importing high-quality overseas scrap. China's own scrap output has fallen while imports are up about 11%, which supports demand for US copper scrap.

headline: Chinese copper scrap prices drop sharply while stainless scrap edges up
detail: Bare bright, #1 and #2 copper scrap in China each fell about CNY 3,150/t in one session, with brass and aluminum scrap also lower. It is an early read on where export bids for nonferrous scrap are heading.

headline: High Midwest aluminum premium squeezes can buyers as regulators review the benchmark
detail: Drink makers report margin pressure from aluminum cans, and the CFTC chair ordered a review of the Midwest premium. Any change to the benchmark would reprice UBC and other aluminum scrap tied to it.

headline: Cox sees November new-vehicle sales steady at about a 15.8 million annual pace
detail: Volume is forecast down 7% from a year ago because of fewer selling days, but the daily selling rate is up slightly. Steady car production keeps prime busheling flowing to Midwest mills.

headline: October housing starts jump 9.9% but permits fall to their lowest since May 2020
detail: Starts rose mostly on apartment construction while permits fell 7.4%. That points to weaker rebar, wire and copper demand from housing into 2027.

headline: New home sales report due this morning, expected to fall to about 650,000
detail: Forecasters expect a drop of about 4% from September. Another weak reading would confirm the housing slowdown weighing on construction metals demand.

headline: COMEX copper had its steepest one-day drop in eight months last week
detail: December COMEX copper fell about 4.9% on Nov 18 as speculators unwound positions, leaving it about 17% below its September record. Copper's gain for the year has nearly disappeared.

headline: Nickel gives back its rally as Indonesia's 2027 mining quota stays uncertain
detail: LME nickel slipped from about $16,500/t on Nov 18 to near $15,450/t. High stocks and weak battery demand cap prices, keeping stainless and nickel-alloy scrap soft.

headline: Gold is down about a third from its January record after its worst week since March
detail: Spot gold briefly touched about $3,514 on Nov 20, its lowest since September 2025, as futures priced in a December hike. Silver, platinum and palladium fell too.

headline: China's yuan hits a three-week high, but trade tensions cap the gain
detail: The central bank's daily fixing was its strongest since July 2022. A firmer yuan helps China buy imported metal, but new US tariff threats cloud the outlook.

headline: Beijing's party newspaper pushes back on economic gloom as Chinese stocks tumble
detail: The People's Daily admitted the property slump and weak demand but rejected pessimism after October data missed across the board. There is still no sign of the big stimulus metals bulls want.

headline: Platinum council forecasts the market will swing back to a deficit in 2027
detail: The WPIC expects a 279,000 oz shortfall in 2027 after a surplus this year, as South African mine supply weakens. That supports a longer-term floor under converter values.

headline: Stellantis sues the Unifor union over access to its idled Brampton plant
detail: Stellantis says the union is blocking work needed to sell the plant. Shrinking North American assembly capacity means less factory scrap over time.

headline: US EV share falls below 6% after the federal tax credit ended
detail: EV market share has roughly halved from its peak as GM and Ford lean toward hybrids. That trims expected copper and aluminum demand from EVs.

headline: Texas troopers seize 632 catalytic converters from a stolen trailer
detail: The driver faces felony theft and converter-possession charges under Texas law. Enforcement keeps pressure on converter buyers to document where material comes from.

headline: Zinc smelter fees stay deeply negative, so output cuts are possible
detail: Chinese zinc fell below RMB 24,000/t while fees smelters earn for processing ore stay deeply negative. Squeezed smelters could cut output, which would eventually support zinc prices.

headline: Panama holds first formal talks with First Quantum on the closed Cobre Panama copper mine
detail: Nothing was decided; a limited restart ahead of final closure is being studied. Any restart would add supply to a copper market already under pressure.
